{{Quote|This is taking too long. Destroy that cruiser.''"<br />"''But sir, there are still hundreds of droids on board!''"<br />"''I don't care!''"<br />"''Roger, roger.|TF-1726 and a B1 battle droid|<ref name="Crash" />}}
'''TF-1726''' was a [[Gender/Legends|masculine]]-programmed [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] who served in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Commander/Legends|commanded]] a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] during the [[Sky Battle of Quell]], in which he ambushed a [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] of [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]]. During the course of the battle over [[Quell/Legends|Quell]], TF-1726 lost one of his own [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]], but his remaining forces were able to destroy two of Secura's [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], leaving only Secura's own [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]], the [[Liberty (Venator-class)/Legends|''Liberty'']], maintaining altitude. The tactical [[Droid/Legends|droid]] then sent hundreds of [[B2-RP battle droid/Legends|B2-RP battle droids]] to invade the damaged [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]].

While the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] attacked the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], an evacuation party led by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] arrived to help by sending an evacuation party to Secura's crippled [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], destroying many droids aboard. Becoming impatient due to the prolongation of the battle, the tactical droid ordered his [[TF-1726's Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|frigate's]] [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]] to open fire on the ''Liberty''. As a result, all of the droids still aboard the destroyer went down with it, although Secura, [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly]], and the evacuation party managed to escape the ship before its destruction. After the Republic's [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Quell)/Legends|evacuation cruiser]] accidentally jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], TF-1726's fleet was left to continue the battle with the remaining [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces, which ultimately led to a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] victory.

==Biography==
{{Quote|We have them now. Send in the super droids.|TF-1726, during the battle|<ref name="Crash" />}}
Manufactured by [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]],<ref name="GAW" /> TF-1726<ref name="Maxi Poster">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Clone-Poster-Characters/dp/B003E4WSK4|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars - TV Show / Movie Poster (All Characters) (Size: 24" x 36")}}</ref> was a [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]]<ref name="GAW" /> who served in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Crash" /> During the [[22 BBY/Legends|first year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="Atlas Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quell/Legends|Quell]] had become a contested site between the Confederacy and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|location|quell|Quell}}</ref> Quell's state of contention soon escalated when TF-1726's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of seven [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] ambushed [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura's]] [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] of three [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] in the highest levels of the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], initiating the [[Sky Battle of Quell]].<ref name="Crash" />

[[File:B1_and_tactical_droid_Battle_of_Quell.png|thumb|left|280px|TF-1726 and a B1 battle droid on his frigate]]
While the cluster of Separatist [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] pelted the trio of ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] with concentrated [[Blaster cannon/Legends|cannonades]], the tactical [[Droid/Legends|droid]] deployed several [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid fighters]] to [[Starfighter combat/Legends|engage]] the Republic's [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]]. Although one of the ''Munificent''-class frigates was shot down by the Republic Star [[Destroyer/Legends|Destroyers]], the Confederacy started to gain the advantage, by concentrating intense [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] [[Laser/Legends|fire]] on the outnumbered Republic flotilla&ndash;ultimately sending two of Secura's damaged [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] to the surface of the planet.<ref name="Crash" /> Before long, Secura's personal [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]], the [[Liberty (Venator-class)/Legends|''Liberty'']],<ref name="Crash Decoded">{{TCW|Jedi Crash|d=y}}</ref> lost its [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], prompting TF-1726 to order several hundred [[Rocket pack/Legends|rocket pack]]&ndash;equipped<ref name="Crash" /> [[B2-RP battle droid/Legends|B2-RP battle droids]]<ref name="OEG:S1">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''</ref> to board the crippled [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. The [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] invaded the ''Liberty'', although another Republic ship, the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], arrived from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and dispatched an evacuation party, led by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], aboard several [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] and a [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] to evacuate Secura and her crew.<ref name="Crash" />

The evacuation party and Secura's remaining forces were able to destroy several battle droids aboard the ''Liberty'', which delayed the battle's outcome as TF-1726 had calculated.<ref name="Crash" /> Not tolerating the wait, as his forces should have won four [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] prior,<ref name="Crash Decoded" /> the droid ordered his [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]] to concentrate all of the frigate's fire at the ''Liberty'', ignoring the fact that hundreds of battle droids were still on board. The resulting laser bombardment set the destroyer's inner corridors on fire, which consumed battle droids and Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] alike. However, Skywalker, Secura, and the evacuation party were able to escape from the ship aboard the ''Consular''-class cruiser just before the ''Liberty'' was completely destroyed. When the group tried to board the ''Resolute'', the tactical droid's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] attacked their cruiser, causing the ship's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] to accidentally activate. The cruiser jumped to hyperspace, leaving the ''Resolute'' and its [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], to continue the battle against TF-1726's Confederate fleet.<ref name="Crash" /> The battle would eventually not end well for the remaining Republic forces, turning into a victory for the Separatists over Quell.<ref name="Planets in Peril">''[[The Clone Wars: Planets in Peril]]''</ref>

==Characteristics==
[[File:Tactical_droid_Quell.png|thumb|right|250px|TF-1726 gives commands to his crew during the Sky Battle of Quell.]]
As a tactical droid, TF-1726 had his own individual [[Color/Legends|color]] scheme,<ref name="TCWCE" /> which was green and white.<ref name="Crash" /> He was built by [[Baktoid Industries/Legends|Baktoid]] to be 1.93 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height,<ref name="TCWCE" /> with [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] programming and white [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]].<ref name="Crash" /> Like all tactical droids, he was far more intelligent than the standard battle droids of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. Not controlled by a [[Central Control Computer/Legends|central control computer]], he could think and function independently.<ref name="IoR">{{SW|url=video/innocents-of-ryloth-episode-featurette|text="Innocents of Ryloth" Episode Featurette}}</ref> A calculating droid in battle,<ref name="EPG">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode013.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Jedi Crash}}</ref> he estimated that the invading battle droids would swiftly win the battle. However, he started to grow impatient as the battle progressed.<ref name="Crash" /> When his forces failed to achieve victory as scheduled, being late by four minutes,<ref name="Crash Decoded" /> he changed plans and ordered the ''Liberty'' to be targeted and destroyed immediately. A [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] gunner reminded him that hundreds of droids were still aboard the cruiser, but he claimed not to care, lacking any concern for them.<ref name="Crash" />

==Behind the scenes==
A picture of this tactical droid was first seen in ''[[The Clone Wars: Headgames]]'', an [[Star Wars comic books|issue]] of the online [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' webcomic series]]. The picture was a screenshot from the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series episode "[[Jedi Crash]]," in which the tactical droid made his first on-screen appearance, voiced by [[Matthew Wood]]. In the episode, the droid did not receive a name, but his appearance marked the debut of the T-series tactical droid model on the show. The unnamed droid later received the name "TF-1726" on a [http://www.amazon.com/dp/B003E4WSK4 promotional poster] for the series.

TF-1726 also appeared in the non-[[canon]]ical [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''. In the game's adaption of "Jedi Crash," the droid is surveying the Sky Battle of Quell when his B1 battle droid subordinate spots the ''Consular''-class cruiser approaching the ''Liberty''. The B1 droid shakes the tactical droid and points out the cruiser, after which the tactical droid orders one of his frigates to capture the cruiser. One of the frigates then traps the cruiser with a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] but is soon destroyed by Skywalker, allowing the cruiser to continue with the evacuation.
